name: Matplotlib
description: Comprehensive library for creating static, animated and interactive visualizations in Python.
summary: Matplotlib allows AI for learning and solution ideas, and permits AI-assisted contributions only when contributors could solve the work without AI, remain responsible, understand and verify the output, and disclose AI use in pull requests. External AI agents may not create issues or pull requests or comment, AI may not write PR summaries, AI-generated good-first-issue pull requests are closed, and low-value AI-generated contributions are rejected; translating or proofreading one's own comments or PR descriptions is allowed if the wording stays close to the original.

As with any tool, the resulting contribution is the responsibility of the human contributor.

We expect dedicated and authentic engagement in our community. In particular when using AI, carefully consider what and how to communicate, question results, think things through thoroughly and make well-informed decisions.

Using AI output without ensuring that you fully understand the output or without verifying that it is the correct approach.
